acceptance_scope: Only Step 2 baselines and prospective protocol. Trained predictor acceptance remains NOT_ASSESSED_NO_PREDICTOR.

measurement.aggregation: equal anchors/episode/camera/horizon, equal variants/group, equal groups/task, equal tasks/cameras/horizons

collapse.compare: prediction versus corresponding frozen teacher targets per camera; no spatial-only variance shortcut
collapse.effective_rank: entropy effective rank of eigenvalues of weighted covariance of 64-token pooled group means
collapse.fixed_position_std: task/group-weighted RMS std across group means at corresponding spatial positions
collapse.independent_unit: mean of query features within each numeric group
collapse.panel: all 9 fixed query targets per representative validation group, including retrieval-ineligible queries
collapse.similarity: mean cosine between normalized pooled group means within each task, then equal tasks

measurement.cosine: 1 minus FP64 dot product of unit FP32 vectors, clipped to [0,2]; mean over 64 spatial tokens per camera
measurement.coverage: all 1109994 validation pairs, 1528 episodes, 180 groups, 40 tasks, two cameras

gate.qualitative: review all 480 fixed Week 5 example identities with feature/prediction diagnostics
gate.rationale: prospective practical-effect thresholds for this study, not universal literature cutoffs
gate.selection: fixed final CPT endpoint from Step 4; no best-checkpoint search or automatic extension

measurement.motion: Week 5 exact 128x128 truth-defined change mask; each 8x8 token gets the fraction of changed pixels in its aligned 16x16 mask tile; aggregate error masses/areas

retrieval.aggregation: equal eligible queries within group, equal supported groups/task, equal tasks; also report camera/horizon coverage and scores
retrieval.candidate_proposals: true target plus unique floor(linspace(0,L-1,33)); same episode/camera only
retrieval.duplicates: reject equal RGB SHA256 or cosine distance <=0.01 against any retained candidate; never relax separation
retrieval.episode: one validation variant per numeric group, minimum SHA256(week6-jepa-retrieval-v1:episode_index)
retrieval.incomplete_pool: mark ineligible with reason/count; no smaller pool or replacement query
retrieval.pool_freeze: retain exact candidates and target slot before predictor training; content filtering uses frozen teacher only
retrieval.score: mean same-position cosine similarity over all 64 tokens; joint cameras are not mixed
retrieval.ties: within 1e-8 of true score: expected Recall@1/@3 and reciprocal rank under uniform tie breaking

training_mean.averaging: equal selected frames within group, equal groups within task; final per-position unit L2
training_mean.label: sampled train-only task/camera/position mean; not the full training empirical mean

uncertainty.scope: conditional on these tasks and frozen development split
uncertainty.unit: numeric groups within each fixed task; paired draws

prelaunch_source_revision.reason: Add strict pilot/full identity matching before any remote execution; measurement rules, thresholds and selection unchanged.

resources.feature_cache: one episode in memory; retain only two replay episodes and fixed group-mean panels
resources.pilot: shortest and longest representative TRAIN episodes; full frame encode/metrics/retrieval, no optimizer
